name: Infinite Empire
storyline: Become the Lord Captain of an ancient space fortress in a galaxy where railguns sit next to necromantic hull plating, steam-powered tesla cannons, and biological spore launchers. Build your ship and then build your empire!
summary: Infinite Empire is a strategy and simulation game that blends 4X and LitRPG mechanics within a sci-fi and fantasy universe featuring steampunk, bio-organic, and necromantic aesthetics. A core feature is modular ship building, where players physically draw their hulls and place components that directly impact their tactical vulnerabilities. These massive vessels engage in slow, deliberate "Age of Sail" style combat focused on positioning and broadside attacks. Between battles, players expand their territory in a dynamic galaxy, managing an escalating notoriety system against autonomous AI factions while looting and crafting hybrid technologies.
